findings.text: the linger guard rests on a type the test itself constructs: _linger_failure returns getattr(service, "LingerUnavailable", service.ServiceError) and the fake manager raises it at tests/test_watch_seat_across_hosts.py:176, so nothing drives the real service.enable_linger (reckon/service.py:201) — reverting that raise to a bare ServiceError leaves all five tests green (reviewer-mutation-service-raise.log) and production crew watch --ensure goes back to raising on a node whose loginctl refuses.

the assertion cannot fail, because _read_seat returns {} for an erased record and {}.get("host") is None too, so the hostless erasure the test is named for is not guarded by it — a mutation that erases the hostless seat and still answers live off its stream leaves all five tests green (reviewer-mutation-hostless-erasure.log).
